source.name: Tabbing past the last visible control of a modal must wrap inside the modal even when it contains hidden buttons
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/ghosh/micromodal/issues/295) at 777dbcbeaf6314da0a3669f2b5ed9cdd66e6fc8a. Blind to the maintainers' fix 70dfd4320d9e0e535be432f57c698c75e230d0b3; routing auto.

journey.title: Tab stays inside the upload dialog when it contains a hidden button
journey.goal: Tabbing past the last visible control wraps to the start of the dialog

steps.title: Tab past the last visible control

functionalJourney.title: Upload a report with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens, uploads and closes

guards.title: Escape closes the upload dialog and returns focus
guards.goal: Escape dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

plan.root_cause: The focus trap incorrectly includes hidden elements (e.g., buttons with display:none) in the focusable node list, causing the last focusable element to be misidentified and allowing Tab to escape the modal.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify getFocusableNodes to filter out elements that are not visually rendered (display:none or visibility hidden) using computed styles, ensuring only truly focusable nodes are considered for wrapping.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tabbing within the modal will now properly wrap to the first focusable element when reaching the last, keeping focus inside the dialog for keyboard users.
functional_risks: Potential performance impact due to computing styles for each focusable node on each keydown.
Risk of incorrectly hiding nodes that are programmatically focusable but temporarily off-screen.
Possible interference with custom elements that rely on JS for visibility.
verification_requirements: Verify that tabbing from the last visible control (Upload button) loops back to the first control (filename input) and does not move to the help link.
Confirm that Escape still closes the dialog and returns focus to the triggering button.
Ensure screen reader announcement of modal content remains unchanged.
Check that the hidden retry button remains non-focusable and does not affect tab order.
